community_share_link_help: Signed-in members can open this link. You can revoke it at any time.
community_profile_failed: Could not load this member’s activity history.
segment_catalog_empty: No discovered segments have been completed yet.
segment_catalog_empty_mine: You haven’t completed any discovered segments yet.
segment_catalog_failed: Could not load the segment catalog.
segment_no_personal_efforts: You haven’t completed this segment yet.
segment_rescan_queued: Segment rescan queued. Refresh results to check for new efforts.
segment_rescan_failed: Could not queue the segment rescan. Try again.
segment_refresh_failed: Could not load segment results. Try again.
segment_no_matches: No segment efforts found for this activity yet.
segment_catalog_coverage: Strava segment coverage varies by area.
segment_leaderboard_failed: Could not load the Local KOM leaderboard.
overview_intro: Self-hosted multi-source activity tracker. This UI talks to this instance via the /admin/* endpoints.
token_missing_hint: Set the environment variable before starting npm run dev:
activities_no_user: No user — create one through the admin API first.
activities_empty: No activities yet. Connect Strava/Garmin or upload a FIT file.
detail_streams_pending: Stream data exists — the frontend is waiting on the ActivityService.GetStream Connect RPC.
admin_intro: Operator console. Mirrors the server's /admin/* HTTP endpoints.
notifications_intro: PR alerts, segment leaderboards, system events.
notifications_pending: This page is waiting on the NotificationService.List RPC. The server already has the use case (see usecase/notification) but the Connect handler isn't mounted yet.
settings_appearance_description: System follows your device’s color scheme. This setting is saved in this browser.
connections_intro: Connect your own provider accounts. Each provider needs your own OAuth app credentials — this instance never ships shared keys.
connections_error_exchange_failed: Provider rejected the connection. Check your credentials.
gear_intro: Your bikes and shoes. Gear is attached to activities from your connected providers, or by you; totals are computed from your activities.
gear_defaults_intro: Applied once to manual and uploaded activities when they are created. Imported activities take the gear your provider recorded.
gear_empty: No gear yet. Add a bike or a pair of shoes, or sync gear from a connected account.
gear_pending_intro: A provider reported gear this instance does not know yet. Create it as new gear, or map it onto gear you already have.
gear_sync_hint: Provider gear lists are synced with every reconcile; use “Sync gear” on Connections to fetch them now.
gear_prompt_text: No gear set for this activity.
gear_prompt_dismiss_hint: This activity used no gear — stop asking
gear_confirm_delete: Delete “{name}”? {count} activities keep no gear afterwards.
gear_confirm_merge: Merge “{from}” into “{to}”? Its activities and provider records move over; this cannot be undone.
gear_sync_queued: Gear sync queued — new gear shows up under Gear as the worker reports it.
review_dup_hint: Looks like the same workout imported twice from one provider.
garmin_intro: Use a personal API key to import your cycling history and sync new rides automatically.
garmin_create_key: Create a key in Garmin Connect
garmin_no_sync: The first sync has not finished yet.
garmin_status_failed: Could not load Garmin Connect status.
garmin_invalid_key: Garmin did not accept this key. Create a new Personal API key and try again.
garmin_key_expired: Garmin no longer accepts this key. Save a new key to resume syncing.
garmin_different_account: This key belongs to a different Garmin account. Disconnect the current account before switching.
garmin_rate_limit: Garmin is limiting requests. Try again later.
garmin_quota: Your activity limit was reached. Free up space to continue syncing.
garmin_unavailable: Could not reach Garmin Connect. Try again in a moment.
garmin_sync_failed: Garmin sync was interrupted. The import will retry.
garmin_queue_failed: Could not start a Garmin sync. Try again.
garmin_request_failed: Could not update Garmin Connect. Try again.
ride_replay_no_gps: Replay requires at least two recorded GPS timestamps.
ride_replay_load_failed: The recorded route could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
ride_terrain_fallback: 3D terrain is unavailable. Replay continues in 2D.
ride_terrain_accuracy: The map uses a public elevation model. Terrain detail varies by location.
ride_estimate_coverage: {share} of elapsed time had enough data to estimate power
ride_estimate_load_failed: Unable to check the recorded samples.
ride_estimate_accuracy: Estimated Power can be significantly inaccurate, especially in wind, under braking or when GPS elevation is noisy.
ride_estimate_defaults: The defaults assume paved roads and a typical road-bike position (rolling resistance 0.005, drag area 0.35 m²). Leave wind blank to omit it from the model.
ride_estimate_insufficient: This ride has insufficient continuous speed and elevation data for Estimated Power.
segment_rivalry_description: Compare members who rode this segment.
segment_rivalry_history_select: Select up to four riders to compare their times.
segment_rivalry_history_limit: Showing up to the {count} most recent efforts per rider.
comparison_intro: Choose a member to compare your cycling segments and personal records.
comparison_no_members: There are no other members to compare with.
comparison_member_unavailable: This member is unavailable for comparison.
comparison_no_segments: No shared cycling segments with visible efforts. Members can choose who can compare a ride when editing it.
comparison_no_records: No comparable cycling records yet. Members can choose who can compare a ride when editing it.
comparison_sharing_help: Choose which performance data members can compare on your shared rides. Speed, power and heart-rate records also require Personal Records to be enabled.
comparison_sharing_load_failed: Could not load your sharing settings.
comparison_sharing_save_failed: Could not save your sharing settings.
comparison_privacy_help: Head-to-Head uses ride visibility and your sharing settings. Followers can compare eligible efforts on rides shared with them.
friends_failed: Unable to load the member directory.
segment_search_empty: No segment names match your search.
segment_map_zoom_in: Zoom in to see segment routes.
segment_map_empty: No matching segments in this area.
segment_map_more: Zoom in to see more segments in this area.
segment_sort_help: Sorts in the order shown. Shift-click a column header to add it or reverse its direction.
member_segment_no_efforts: This member has no efforts on this segment yet.
member_activity_insights_description: Data sources and downloads for this activity.
heatmap_preparation_stalled: Heatmap preparation stopped making progress. Reload to try again.
heatmap_open_activity: Select a track to open its activity.
heatmap_inspect: Hover or tap a route to inspect its averages and passage count.
record_no_results: No valid results for this selection.
strava_connection_help: Peloton reads your cycling history and streams from Strava. Rides imported only from Strava are visible to you.
strava_oauth_denied: Strava authorization was declined. Try connecting again when you are ready.
strava_oauth_scope_missing: Allow access to all activities on Strava to import rides marked Only You.
strava_sync_unavailable: Could not start the Strava check. Check the connection and try again when the importer and API are available.
connections_disconnect_confirm: Disconnect this account? Imported activities will stay.
waas_intro: Build a cycling loop around the Waasland with the climbs, surfaces and places you enjoy.
waas_place_search: Find a church, market square, dike or ferry landing
waas_places_help: The planner chooses the order in your riding direction. Ferry places refer to the landing.
waas_copy_failed: Could not copy the link. You can copy the address from your browser.
waas_distance_warning: This ride is outside your chosen distance margin.
waas_gain_warning: Estimated ascent is outside your chosen elevation range.
waas_import_help: Distance and ascent use the exported GPS track, including every repeated passage. Keep the original route when importing into another planner.
waas_estimate_help: Ascent is estimated from distance-smoothed heights with a 3 m noise threshold. Tagged bridge deck estimates are retained. Sources include DHM Vlaanderen II and BRouter.
waas_weather_unavailable: Current wind is unavailable. Route planning still works.
waas_map_unavailable: The map is unavailable. The elevation profile and GPX remain usable.
waas_idle: Choose your ride profile and distance to plan a loop.
waas_range_error: Maximum ascent must be at least the minimum.
waas_error: The ride could not be calculated. Please try again.
waas_dirty: Your choices changed. Plan the ride again to apply them.
waas_connection_progress: Calculating cycling connections through your places…
analysis_form_description: The balance between long-term and short-term load. Negative means you've trained harder than usual recently.
analysis_training_estimated: Training load uses recorded Training Stress Scores when available and estimates for other activities. No heart-rate or power values are filled in.
records_downhill_help: Cycling speed and distance records require enough GPS and elevation to rule out significant downhill assistance.
comparison_pair_intro: Choose two riders to compare their cycling segments and personal records.
